g.text: Server reads auth_token HttpOnly cookie and forwards Bearer JWT.
Cookie: SameSite=Lax, Secure in production, 24-hour max-age.
Browser receives user data, not the JWT in the login JSON body.
Schema script grants access to pandastore_backend with RLS policies.
Application users use Spring authentication; Supabase Auth and
direct browser Data API access are not part of this implementation.
No external payment provider or courier API is configured.
Runtime component dependencies, not an exhaustive class inventory.
